components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one amber pill action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 980px; background: #f2b134; color: #1a1405; font: 400 17px/1.47 Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.022em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffc24d; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #e09f1f; transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2b134; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: 16px; background: #0f1b2f; color: #f4f1ea; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(244, 241, 234, 0.12); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; color: #aab5c8; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.014em; } .ds-card-value { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Floating Label Field
components.description: 56px field whose label rises when filled or focused.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: block; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 25px 16px 8px; border: 1px solid #5d6f8f; border-radius: 11px; background: #0f1b2f; color: #f4f1ea; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.022em; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f2b134; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(242, 177, 52, 0.55); } .ds-field-label { position: absolute; top: 17px; left: 17px; color: #aab5c8; font-size: 17px; line-height: 21px; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: left top; transition: transform 0.125s; } .ds-input:not(:placeholder-shown) + .ds-field-label, .ds-input:focus + .ds-field-label { transform: translateY(-9px) scale(0.705); }

components.name: Choice Tile
components.description: One-tap option; selected is an amber frame with a soft amber wash.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 96px; min-height: 56px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #5d6f8f; border-radius: 11px; background: #0f1b2f; color: #f4f1ea; font: 600 17px/1.24 Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: #aab5c8; } .ds-tile-on { border-color: #f2b134; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #f2b134; background: rgba(242, 177, 52, 0.16); color: #8db6ff; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill with a status dot and always a word.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1b2c49; color: #f4f1ea; font: 600 13px/1.4 Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3ddc97; }

components.css: .ds-tank { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 28px; border-radius: 16px; background: #0f1b2f; color: #f4f1ea; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(244, 241, 234, 0.12); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-tank-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-tank-pct { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-meter { position: relative; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1d2f4f; overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-fill { width: 72%; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: #5b9cff; transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-grow 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.28, 0.11, 0.32, 1) both 0.15s; } .ds-meter-mark { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 20%; width: 2px; background: #0f1b2f; } .ds-tank-foot { color: #aab5c8; font-size: 14px; } @keyframes ds-grow { from { transform: scaleX(0); } }

components.name: Shift Line
components.description: Signature: the Poste as a four-stop transit line. Past stops and bars amber, current stop a burning ring, future stops hollow.
components.html:
1. Ouverture
  2. Ventes
  3. Clôture
  4. Validation
components.css: .ds-shift { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; padding: 12px; list-style: none; background: #070e1b; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-shift li { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-shift li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 11px; left: 22px; right: -2px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #2b3d5d; } .ds-shift li:last-child::before { display: none; } .ds-shift li.done::before { background: #f2b134; } .ds-stop { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #070e1b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #2b3d5d; } .ds-shift .done .ds-stop { background: #f2b134; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #f2b134; } .ds-shift .now .ds-stop { background: #070e1b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px #f2b134; } .ds-stop-label { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #8391ab; } .ds-shift .done .ds-stop-label { color: #aab5c8; } .ds-shift .now .ds-stop-label { color: #f4f1ea; }

components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1b2c49; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #aab5c8; font: 400 14px Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #f4f1ea; } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: #53688d; color: #f4f1ea; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2b134; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The product is a midnight-blue enamel board read under pump-island lights. The ground is a deep blue-black, panels are lacquered navy edged by a one-pixel porcelain hairline, type is warm porcelain, and a single amber ink marks every action. Gasoil and essence each own a line colour (cobalt and coral) that follows the product through gauges, bars and charts. Premium, calm and legible: the Gérant reads credit, combos and stock on one board, and the Pompiste records a sale in a few taps.

Dark is the default. A day mode (white enamel, darker amber, deeper link blue) is chosen from the account menu for full sun and swaps the same token names, so no component is restyled. Inter, served from the station itself, is the only face on every device. Density is generous on phones (44px minimum tap targets, 56px fields) and tidy on desktop (1068px page column).

Depth comes from hairlines and tonal steps, not shadows. Motion is short and answers the hand or explains a state; the one signature moment is the balanced till (drawn check, ripple, counted figure).
keyCharacteristics: Midnight ground, lacquered navy panels, porcelain text, amber as the only action ink.
One line colour per product, status colours always paired with a word.
Inter throughout, tight negative tracking, tabular figures for every amount.
Pill-shaped controls over softly rounded (16px) panels.
Hairline-edged panels with no resting shadow.
Signature: the shift line, a four-stop transit line for the Poste.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only action colour. It marks what can be pressed or what has been done; it never decorates.

rules.name: The Line Per Product Rule
rules.body: Gasoil is cobalt, essence is coral, everywhere a product is drawn. Series colours never stand in for status.

rules.name: The Word Beside The Colour Rule
rules.body: Status is never colour alone: every dot, disc or variance carries a word or sign.

rules.name: The Two Modes Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a token with a day value. Components read tokens and never hard-code a mode.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every amount, percentage and count is set with tabular figures so columns and counters hold still.

rules.name: The Tight Track Rule
rules.body: Headings and figures carry negative tracking that grows with size (-0.014em at 19px to -0.03em at 48px).

rules.name: The Quiet Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels sit on a hairline, not a shadow. A shadow means the element is above the page.

dos: Do colour every action in amber (#f2b134, day #b86a00) with dark text, and only actions or completed steps.
Do reference tokens (`var(--surface)`, `var(--text-2)`, `var(--accent)`) so day mode follows automatically.
Do colour products by their line (gasoil cobalt, essence coral) wherever they are charted.
Do set amounts in tabular figures at 600 weight and tighten tracking as size grows.
Do separate panels from the ground with the 1px hairline and the one-step tonal change.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more and fields at 56px on touch surfaces.
Do pair status colour with a word or sign, and use the lighter `-text` status colours for text on navy.
Do keep the French product terms (Gérant, Pompiste, Poste, Cuve) in the interface.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour or use amber for decoration.
Don't put a resting shadow on a panel; reserve shadows for floating layers.
Don't use pure black or pure white as the ground; the dark ground is #070e1b and the day ground #eceff5.
Don't use neon-on-black dashboard colours or glow as ornament; the only glow is the current shift-line stop.
Don't animate layout properties; use transform and opacity.
Don't convey status by colour alone.
Don't reintroduce a light-grey tile look or a second typeface.
